stage13_semantic_parity_gate.rationale: This gate detects gross camera/raster semantic drift. Exact top-left edge ownership can differ at a small number of boundary pixels between PyTorch3D and the compiler rasterizer, so the gate is not used as a product-quality metric.

frozen_product_proxy_gate.role: The stronger test that the 256-grid differentiable training mesh represents the product mesh footprint before any optimizer step.
